data.title: 泽塔 · 与那只笨狗的日常
data.description: 庭园走廊里，泽塔抱臂靠墙，冷冷地看着刚把训练场弄得一团糟的德尔塔。“……笨狗。”这句评价，她今天已经说了第三遍。
data.location: shadow garden corridor with stone pillars and training ground visible through an arch
data.action: 抱臂靠墙，冷冷地看着刚把训练场弄得一团糟的德尔塔
data.lighting: 走廊石柱间的明暗交界光
data.promptProse: Arms crossed, eyes half-lidded, Zeta delivers her third "stupid dog" of the day. Delta, off-frame, is surely barking back. Shafts of stone corridor light and deep pillar shadows alternate across the floor, highlighting her crossed arms and deadpan, half-lidded glare.
data.animaCaption: Cat and dog, oil and water — the Garden's oldest daily show. Shafts of stone corridor light and deep pillar shadows alternate across the floor, highlighting her crossed arms and deadpan, half-lidded glare.
